artifacts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create exactly one premium vertical 2:3 collectible-card foil booster dedicated exclusively to the original Multiverse Breach universe ‘Thalassa Mnémique’. Composition: one straight-on sealed packet, centered and completely visible from the top crimped seam to the bottom crimped seam, with generous dark cosmic margin. Realistic metallic foil, embossed framing, controlled holographic reflections and one circular luminous breach portal in the center. Palette: abyssal navy #061d2b, near-black #01070d, mnemonic turquoise #64e6dd, aged copper, pearl-white coral and restrained warm gold #e8bd70. Central portal illustration: a submerged civic memory archive built from pale coral, brass pressure locks and glass maps. The unique Leviathan of Drowned Names dominates the depth: a colossal whale-like glass skull, cathedral-coral ribs, deep teal fins, thousands of luminous testimony ribbons without writing, and a false dawn glowing inside its chest. In the foreground show only Neris Vale, Oryn Pell and Sio Lume as three small readable action silhouettes with their canonical equipment. Text, verbatim, and absolutely no other visible text: ‘THALASSA MNÉMIQUE’; ‘UNIVERSE’; ‘BREACH PORTAL BOOSTER’; ‘5 UNLOCKABLES’; ‘ANOMALY SERIES’. Constraints: exactly one physical packet and one coherent wholly original project-owned illustration; circular portal clearly visible; all wrapper edges uncropped. Avoid: collage, grid, multiple packets, loose cards, hands, shelf, landscape-only composition, crossover elements, pseudo-text, logo, watermark or cropped seams.
